source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
If this model leads a **KASTELAN ROBOTS** unit at one of these points, that unit enters a protocol:

- as the battle begins, it enters Aegis Protocol
- in your Command phase, you can pick 1 protocol below for it to enter

A unit stays in a protocol until it switches to another. Each protocol affects the **KASTELAN ROBOT** models in the unit:

- **Protector Protocol**: +2 Attacks for their ranged weapons
- **Conqueror Protocol**: +2 Attacks for their melee weapons
- **Aegis Protocol**: +1 Toughness
